notes: NotebookEdit reads its target from notebook_path, not file_path, and a notebook is never an engine-owned file, so it denies unconditionally while pending. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
